was: Private RV park on a working farm (cattle pens and grain bins beside the sites) on County Rd 8 at the I-80 Big Springs interchange, next to a Maverik. Hosts let you choose your site; storm shelter on site. CAMPER-REPORTED RATE: $40 a night in October 2026 (RV Life review); the park has no web page of its own, only a 'Coming Soon' placeholder (2026-11-05). --Claude

was: Iowa state park on high cliff overlooking 72-acre Red Haw Lake.  Some sites wooded, some full sun; threaded potable spigot at dump station; roads and facilities are somewhat poorly maintained.  No daily park-entry fee in Iowa, camping fee only.  --AWH  51 public campsites (41 electric, 1 non-electric RV, 9 tent-only) since the campground reopened. 100% reservable on ReserveAmerica, bookable up to 10 pm on the day of arrival (ReserveAmerica and Iowa DNR, read 2026-10-20). --Claude

was: Palo Alto County Conservation Board campground in Lost Island - Huston Park, 3 mi north of Ruthven on the NE side of Lost Island Lake (1,200 acres). The full-hookup sites are lots 1, 2 and 17-24. The park has a swimming beach with dock, a boat ramp, fishing docks, hiking trails and the Lost Island Nature Center; extra vehicles park at the nature center lot. --Claude

was: Page County Conservation Board's North Campground at Pierce Creek Recreation Area (361 acres, a 30-acre lake, trails and public hunting), in woods off 140th St north of Essex, well away from the lake. A camping cabin can be reserved; the park's equestrian campground is a separate loop. --Claude

was: Campground at the Pottawattamie County Fairgrounds in Avoca, home of the Original Pottawattamie County Fair, just off I-80; campers choose a site and pay at the self-pay box (cash). CAMPER-REPORTED RATE: $25 a night (August 2026). --Claude
note: Campground at the Pottawattamie County Fairgrounds in Avoca, home of the Original Pottawattamie County Fair, just off I-80; campers choose a site. --Claude

was: City of Ackley park (101 acres of woods and prairie, six fishing ponds, three miles of trails, disc golf), a quarter mile from downtown; the campground is in the south part of the park, mostly across a creek bridge. Monthly and seasonal stays are also sold. CAMPER-REPORTED RATE: $25 a night (June 2026). --Claude

was: Bremer County Conservation park, 82 acres a mile north of Sumner beside the Wilson Grove Wildlife Area and the A.F. Miller bog preserve in the Little Wapsi floodplain. Lower electric sites plus upper gravel-pad sites with water. Two ponds in Wilson Grove are a short walk from the campground; trails, disc golf, playground, two shelters. Vehicle gate closed after Oct 31. --Claude

was: ~100-site campground; the upper loop is drive-in RV (gravel pads) with 34 electric sites, remainder non-electric; lower sites are walk-to tent. No water/sewer hookups; dump station, showers. Reservable online. Open seasonally ~late April-mid-October. --Claude

was: Sunrise family campground in Kettle Moraine SF Pike Lake Unit; 32 sites (24 wooded, 8 open), 11 with electric. Open early April to third weekend of October. Reservable online. The 3 backpack sites are a separate hike-in area. --Claude
note: Sunrise family campground in Kettle Moraine SF Pike Lake Unit; 32 sites (24 wooded, 8 open), 11 with electric. Reservable online. The 3 backpack sites are a separate hike-in area. --Claude

was: MUNICIPAL - Village of Minong RV park (reservations via Washburn County Parks), not private. 20 full-hookup (W/E/S) RV sites + 5 tent sites; built 2013, expanded 2025; ATV loading ramp, coin showers, flush toilets, dump, pavilion. Open May 1-Oct 15. Reservable online (7-day-advance + 2-night minimum). --Claude  MINIMUM STAY: 2 nights on reservations May 1 - Oct 16, 3 on holiday weekends; unreserved sites are first-come inside 7 days (Washburn County Parks, 2026-10-12). --Claude

was: On Deep Lake (no-wake); RV sites, cabins, tent sites, plus year-round mobile-home spots. Open ~Apr 15/May 1-Oct 15/31. Daily bookable online; seasonal by phone. Leans seasonal but daily availability exists. --Claude

was: Adams County park (2nd-largest county park in WI) on Lake Petenwell, 2004 Bighorn Dr, Arkdale. Large campground with electric and premium/lakefront sites, many with water hookup; heated showers, dump station, swimming area, boat launch, harbor slips. Reservable online or by phone; 2-night min; open year-round. --Claude  MINIMUM STAY: 2 nights on reservations; unreserved sites are first-come (Adams County Parks, 2026-10-12). --Claude

was: Eau Claire County Parks & Forest, on Coon Fork Lake 4 mi E of Augusta (E25501 County Rd CF). 108 sites total incl. 39 electric (30/50-amp) in A and D loops; flush toilets, hot showers, dump, two beaches, non-motorized boat landing, lakeside sites. Season May 1-Sep 15 reservable online (peak), FCFS self-register off-season. Office phone (715) 839-4783. (RV Life unrated) --Claude

was: Chippewa County Facilities & Parks campground on a peninsula in 3,900-acre Lake Holcombe (Holcombe Flowage), ~2.5 mi W of Cty M / Hwy 27, Holcombe. 48 wooded sites, all with 20/30/50-amp electric; many sites directly on the water with some offering boat docks ($5/night dock fee). Beach, swim area, playground, pavilion. Open ~first week of May through last week of October; reservable online May-mid-Sept, FCFS self-registration mid-Sept-Oct. --Claude

was: Oconto County park (RV Life mis-tagged commercial) on the W shore of Green Bay N of Oconto (addr 500 Bay Rd). 34 daily sites + group site; ~6 paved, rest grassy/gravel, all level. Reservable online (2-night min). --Claude  MINIMUM STAY: 2 nights on reservations, 3 on holiday weekends; open sites can be self-registered at the campground (Oconto County parks page, 2026-10-12). --Claude

was: Village of Stockholm park campground on Lake Pepin (Mississippi River). 23 sites with 50-amp electric (count reduced during high water); no water hookup at sites (potable water on-site, arrive with tank filled). Privy toilets, swimming beach, boat ramp, 700' fishing pier. Open seasonally ~April-Oct (April limited by flood risk). Fee envelope/drop box at entrance. --Claude

was: Vernon County Fair Association campground at the county fairgrounds, Viroqua; 56 electric sites (50-amp available), two shower buildings. Open ~May-October except the week of the Vernon County Fair. Contact office; flat grassy fairground sites fit large RVs. --Claude
